text: Interpolates polygon counts regular global discrete grid. Centroid allocation preserves represented source-zone totals smoothing densities across neighboring target cells. Areal allocation preserves global totals.

title: Pycnophylactic interpolation to a grid — to_grid
code: to_grid(   source,   value_col,   id_col = NULL,   grid_type = c("h3", "a5", "s2", "isea3h", "isea4h", "raster", "hex"),   resolution,   cell_inclusion = c("intersect", "centroid"),   cell_allocation = c("centroid", "area"),   nb_order = 1,   max_iter = 500,   tolerance = 1e-04,   include_self = TRUE,   missing_policy = c("abort", "warn", "ignore") )

title: Pycnophylactic interpolation to a grid — to_grid
text: source sf polygon object projected CRS. value_col Column containing values interpolate. May supplied unquoted column name character string. id_col Optional unique identifier column source polygons. grid_type Grid system interpolate . One "h3", "a5", "s2", "isea3h", "isea4h",  "raster", "hex". resolution Grid resolution. H3, A5, S2, ISEA grids grid level. local raster hex grids cell size linear units input projected CRS. cell_inclusion Method used determine grid cells included. One "intersect" "centroid". cell_allocation Method used allocate source values grid cells. "centroid", default, assigns target cell source polygon containing centroid preserves represented source-zone totals. "area" uses fractional source-cell overlap areas. Area allocation experimental: preserves overall represented total may preserve individual source-zone total. nb_order Neighbourhood order used smoothing. value 1 uses first-order neighbours; larger values include higher-order neighbours. max_iter Maximum number pycnophylactic smoothing iterations. 0, returns initial allocation without smoothing. tolerance Convergence tolerance based relative mean density change. include_self Logical. cell include smoothing? missing_policy handle source polygons receive grid cells. One "abort", "warn", "ignore".

title: Pycnophylactic interpolation to a grid — to_grid
text: sf object containing grid-cell geometries interpolated values.

title: Pycnophylactic interpolation to a grid — to_grid
text: cell_allocation = "centroid", represented target cell belongs one source polygon. correction step therefore preserves total associated represented source zone. cell_allocation = "area", target cells may overlap several source polygons. current fractional correction preserves overall represented total guarantee preservation every individual source-zone total. mode experimental.

title: Pycnophylactic interpolation to a grid — to_grid
code: out <- to_grid(   source = nyc_ct_small,   value_col = populationE,   grid_type = "h3",   resolution = 9,   max_iter = 5 )

title: pycnogrid 0.2.1
text: Changed default cell_allocation "area" "centroid". Centroid allocation preserves represented source-zone totals target cell assigned one source polygon. Marked cell_allocation = "area" experimental. Fractional area allocation preserves overall represented total may preserve individual source-zone totals target cells overlap multiple sources. Added regression tests individual source-zone preservation, including zero-valued source zones.

title: pycnogrid 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-10 Added to_grid() main interface pycnophylactic interpolation multiple grid systems. Added support A5, S2, ISEA, local raster local hex grids. Added cell_inclusion cell_allocation options. Added support higher-order neighbourhood smoothing. Added package vignette expanded examples. Improved tests CRAN-readiness.

title: pycnogrid 0.1.0
text: Initial development release. Added to_h3() pycnophylactic interpolation H3 grids. Added example NYC census tract datasets. Added unit tests vignette infrastructure.
